title: Ledger record: hand_turn
description: One HAND-TURN: a step a person performed by hand between a finished actor run and a landed change (issue #319, decision c25). It is a CLAIM about what a person did, never evidence of it: an observing agent writes it as origin=agent authority=proposed against a confirmed `hand_turn_definition` record, a person entering one directly (`nodes hand-turn`) writes it proposed under their own identity, and either reaches `confirmed` only through the ordinary review transaction (PRD §10.8). The record is registered additively after the PRD §10.2 set, like `grade`, and changes nothing in the producer/authority matrix -- there is deliberately no human->observed or human->confirmed-outside-review rule for it. Per-actor stats (`hand_turns_by_stage`) count the CONFIRMED subset only, so the number a delivery summary cites is the number a person ratified.

data.$comment: The three core fields are required: a hand-turn with no description, no stage, or no work item is not countable, and countable is the whole point.

what.description: What the person did, in one line (e.g. `cherry-picked review-fix/t3 onto the PR branch`).

stage.description: The loop stage the turn belongs to. The vocabulary is the confirmed `hand_turn_definition`'s `stages` list (e.g. dispatch, land, review, cleanup); it is a string here so the definition can grow without a schema change.

work_item.description: The work-item key the turn served (a Jira key such as `SCRUM-9`; migrations/0057, decision c41). Stats bucket confirmed turns per work item by this value.

definition_ref.description: The `hand_turn_definition` record this turn was recognised against. Null for a turn a person entered without one -- a real answer, not an omission.

rule.description: The definition rule id that matched (e.g. `commit_without_run`), so a rejected proposal tells the human which rule to iterate.

evidence_refs.description: Pointers to what the observer saw -- commit shas, PR event ids, comment URLs. References, not evidence: the record stays a claim.

observed_at.description: When the turn happened, as read from the source (commit time, comment time), distinct from the envelope's created_at.
